scope: Pilot engineering and evaluation, not broad autonomous learning

claims.claim: 3/4 strict closed loops; 4/4 withdrawals and replacements; 0/2 mistaken withdrawals
claims.caveat: 5 rule units, 6 episodes; inherited/designed errors; one previously explored rule

claims.claim: Content correct counts 12/12 no-note, 10/12 old-note, 12/12 revised-note
claims.caveat: Two errors repeat one task; no content gain over no-memory baseline

claims.claim: 128 controller updates; all held-out actions RETRACT; 0/8 correct and 8/8 SKIP
claims.caveat: External controller only; no LLM weight training; cached action outcomes; one seed

claims.claim: Feedback-note exploration 0/6 versus 1/6 original formula-note comparison
claims.caveat: Exploratory prompt conditioning; unequal note length and extra calls; no parameter update
